name: Lumen
description: Plays files as they are: the browser remuxes them and decodes the audio, the server only sends bytes.
overview: Playback without server-side transcoding for the web client.

versions.changelog: Seeking inside what is already loaded no longer reloads it. The playback log records where the opening time goes.
iPhone and iPad: sound now plays when the device is in silent mode, as in any video app.
With "Play with Lumen" unchecked, files the server direct-plays are no longer played by Lumen. The first logged playback now appears in the log.
Maintenance release: code comments cleaned up, no change in behaviour.
